shorts.title: What you will learn: Hello, C++!
shorts.hook: Five lines of code can say hello to Goa.
shorts.script: Five lines of code can say hello to Goa. Today you write your first C plus plus program. It has only five lines. At the end, your computer says hello to Goa. C plus plus is a programming language. You write instructions in a text file. The computer cannot read that file directly. A tool called a compiler changes your text into a program. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Hello, C++!.

shorts.title: Hello, C++! in one minute
shorts.hook: C plus plus is a programming language.
shorts.script: C plus plus is a programming language. You write instructions in a text file. The computer cannot read that file directly. A tool called a compiler changes your text into a program. Then the computer can run it. Games, web browsers and phone apps use C plus plus. Think of a recipe. You write the steps, and the cook follows them. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Hello, C++! in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The first cout prints a line about you.
shorts.script: The first cout prints a line about you. The second cout prints our sign-off. The computer runs the lines in order, from top to bottom. Then main returns zero and the program ends. The two lines appear, one under the other. C plus plus is a language that you compile. Every program starts in a function called main. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A missing semicolon
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. Here the cout line has no semicolon at the end. The compiler stops and shows an error. It says expected semicolon before return. Every statement in C plus plus must end with a semicolon. Add it, and the program builds. A semicolon ends a statement. Without it, the compiler cannot see where one instruction stops. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: BUG OF THE DAY: A MISSING SEMICOLON
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: A missing semicolon.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: I told my compiler a joke. It said, I do not get it. Expected semicolon.
shorts.script: I told my compiler a joke. It said, I do not get it. Expected semicolon. Write a program that prints your name on one line and your village on the next line. Write your answer in the comments. C plus plus is a language that you compile. Every program starts in a function called main. The tool cout prints text to the screen. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
